brief:
Middle East Eye examined the X account "Habibi," which repeatedly attacked public figures including former Labour leader Ed Miliband, whom it labeled "Palestine Secretary." The account also targeted UK Muslims in its posts, according to MEE's review of its record.

The investigation documented a pattern of harassment against various public figures on the social media platform. MEE characterized the account as operating under the guise of an "expert researcher" while engaging in coordinated attacks on politicians and community members.

title: Habibi X account smeared UK Muslims, targeted Ed Miliband
